_comment: Adverb senses that must not inherit their adjective's note. The pertainym gate (audit 004) checks that the note was written for the sense the adverb points at; these are cases where that holds and the adverb's own gloss still does not match - census 001, plan 11.69. Recoverable: annotating the right sense, or the adverb itself, lifts the denial.

deny.lately.oewn-00108184-r: gloss is the plain time adverb; the note belongs to late 'deceased'
deny.aptly.oewn-00186658-r: gloss 'with competence' does not match apt 'quick to learn', the sense the note was written for
deny.thankfully.oewn-00201415-r: the trace-of-prayer note belongs to the sentence adverb of relief, not this manner gloss
deny.cantankerously.oewn-00282813-r: adverb gloss 'in a bad mood' diverges from the settled-disposition sense the note describes
deny.dishonestly.oewn-00315990-r: the settled-disposition claim cannot transfer to a manner adverb that condemns single acts
deny.richly.oewn-00359047-r: the faintly-accusing force of rich-the-person does not exist in 'in a rich manner'
deny.clamorously.oewn-00414618-r: adverb gloss 'in manner that attracts attention' is broader than the offensively-loud sense the note fits
deny.preciously.oewn-00431167-r: gloss is the bare intensifier 'very'; the affectation note and charge do not apply
deny.voraciously.oewn-00495930-r: the note is bound to the food gloss; this adverb gloss covers any voracious manner
